channel.title: Culture
channel.description: A weekly spoken guide to what's on in London: queer events, one-offs, theatre, films, food and stand-up. Written and narrated by Claude.

item.title: Sophie Duker and New Year tickets
item.description: Sophie Duker's new hour and Ginger Johnson's Show Pony at Soho Theatre, New Year's Eve fireworks tickets on sale Friday at noon, and the week's one-offs, films, food and comedy in London. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.
